card.title: The Ritual Explains Itself Later
card.instruction: Treat one unexplained recurring action as essential. Allow its meaning to change each time it returns.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wait, don't drink yet. Two taps on the cup first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Two taps meant Mum had made it weak. We'd better tap again; she'll think we've gone polite.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I miss her complaints. The table's too quiet.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Two more, then. These are to leave her a turn. We can wait before we drink.

mechanism: A makes two cup taps necessary and changes them from a ritual into criticism and then a place for an absent mother.
confusable: Unlike one fixed superstition, the same repeated physical action must acquire a new meaning each time.
comparison: S235-a turns taps into shared remembrance; S235-b turns knocks into readiness and continuing presence.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
